description: Widen temperature field from i32 to i64 to support higher-precision readings from new sensor hardware
Append an optional battery percentage field at the end of the SensorReading struct for power monitoring
Change speed from signed i16 to unsigned u16 since direction is tracked by the direction enum
Change firmware_version from a fixed 3-element tuple to a variable-length sequence to support semver pre-release segments
Reorder severity enum variants: swap Warning and Critical positions so severity ordering matches numeric discriminant order
Widen error codes from u16 to u32 to support the extended error code range in firmware v2
Widen humidity from f32 to f64 for double-precision environmental readings
Change config from a map to a sequence of key-value tuples for deterministic iteration order
Change error codes from unsigned u16 to signed i16 to encode diagnostic polarity for bidirectional fault indicators
Append a Coast variant to the direction enum for unpowered free-wheeling mode
